---
title: 'mycobank_records'
description: 'Retrieve MycoBank records for a taxon, filtered to Brazilian occurrence evidence'
toc: true
toc-depth: 3
---


```{r}
#| eval: false
fungaR::mycobank_records()
```

### Description

Given a fungal species, genus, or order, retrieves every matching
[MycoBank](https://www.mycobank.org) name and, by default, filters the result
down to only the names whose own MycoBank locality data places them in Brazil -
returning a structured spreadsheet of all available MycoBank information (including
each name's original MycoBank URL) for those Brazilian records. Unlike
`mycobank_gap`, this function does not cross-check FFB at all: it
is a straightforward MycoBank retrieval tool, not a gap/comparison one.

### Details

MycoBank does not offer a public search API suited to bulk automation, but it does
publish a full, regularly-updated bulk export of every name in its database
(https://www.mycobank.org/images/MBList.zip). This function downloads and caches
that export locally (the same way `funga_download` caches the FFB dataset),
then filters it down to the requested species, genus, or order.

The bulk export itself carries no locality information, so determining Brazil evidence
requires visiting each matching name's individual MycoBank page (its
`MycoBank_URL`) to read the "Location details" (and "Host/Substrate") reported for
its type specimen. MycoBank's name pages are a JavaScript single-page application with
no static HTML fallback, so this step (`check_locality = TRUE`, the default)
requires the chromote package (and a local Chrome/Chromium installation) to drive
a headless browser. When `require_brazil_evidence = TRUE` (the default), the
returned table is filtered down to only the names whose MycoBank locality mentions
Brazil; set it to `FALSE` to instead get every matching MycoBank name regardless
of locality (with the evidence columns alongside, for manual review). Brazil-evidence
filtering has no effect if `check_locality = FALSE`, since no locality data is
available to filter on; a message explains this when it happens.

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| taxon | Character. A single fungal species, genus, or order name (e.g. `"Trichoderma harzianum"`, `"Trichoderma"`, or `"Xylariales"`). |
| rank | Character. Whether `taxon` is a `"species"` (default), a `"genus"`, or an `"order"`. |
| check_locality | Logical. If `TRUE` (default), each matching MycoBank name has its own MycoBank name page visited (via chromote) to read the type specimen's reported locality and host/substrate, determining which names MycoBank itself already associates with Brazil. Set to `FALSE` to skip this (much faster, but without locality evidence, and `require_brazil_evidence` has no effect). |
| require_brazil_evidence | Logical. If `TRUE` (default), the returned table is filtered to only the names whose MycoBank locality mentions Brazil. Set to `FALSE` to instead return every matching MycoBank name regardless of locality (with `MycoBank_Brazil_Evidence` alongside for manual review). Only meaningful when `check_locality = TRUE`. |
| max_check | Numeric. Safety cap on how many matching names are sent through the (comparatively slow, one-page-load-per-name) locality check when `check_locality = TRUE`. Defaults to `200`; if more names are found, only the first `max_check` (alphabetically) are checked and a warning is issued. Ignored when `check_locality = FALSE`. |
| mycobank_dir | Character. Local directory used to cache the downloaded MycoBank bulk export. Defaults to `"mycobank_download"`. Reused on subsequent calls to avoid re-downloading the (~140MB) file. |
| verbose | Logical. If `TRUE` (default), prints progress messages. |
| save | Logical. If `TRUE` (default), the result is saved to disk as an `.xlsx` spreadsheet. |
| dir | Character. Directory where the spreadsheet is saved when `save = TRUE`. Defaults to `"mycobank_records"`. |
| filename | Character. Name of the `.xlsx` file (without extension) to save. Defaults to `"mycobank_records_<taxon>"`. |
| html_report | Logical. If `TRUE` (default), also writes a self-contained HTML report (`<dir>/<filename>.html`) summarizing the results: KPI counts, a families-affected breakdown, and the full record table as a sortable, filterable DT widget with buttons to copy or download it as CSV/Excel. Requires the rmarkdown, DT, and htmltools packages; if any is missing, the report is skipped with a message (the `.xlsx` spreadsheet is unaffected). |
| open_report | Logical. If `TRUE` (default in interactive sessions), opens the rendered HTML report in the default browser. |

### Value

A `data.frame`, one row per matching MycoBank name and, by default, with
  a Brazilian MycoBank locality, with columns:

  MycoBank_NumberMycoBank's numeric identifier for the name.
  Taxon_nameThe binomial as registered in MycoBank.
  AuthorsFull author citation.
  YearYear of effective publication.
  Name_statusMycoBank's nomenclatural status (e.g. `"Legitimate"`).
  ClassificationFull MycoBank classification string (Kingdom to genus).
  Current_nameMycoBank's currently accepted name for this entry, when different
    (i.e. when `Taxon_name` is itself a synonym).
  SynonymyMycoBank's full synonymy text (current name and/or basionym, each with
    its complete author/journal/year citation), from the bulk export.
  MycoBank_URLDirect link to the name's MycoBank page.
  MycoBank_Locality, MycoBank_SubstrateType specimen locality and host/substrate
    as reported on the name's own MycoBank page (only when `check_locality = TRUE`).
  MycoBank_EtymologyThe name's etymology, as reported on its own MycoBank page
    (only when `check_locality = TRUE`).
  MycoBank_Name_TypeMycoBank's nomenclatural name type for this entry (e.g.
    `"Basionym"`, `"Combination"`; only when `check_locality = TRUE`).
  MycoBank_Type_SpecimenThe type specimen voucher (e.g. `"URM 80362
    holotype"`; only when `check_locality = TRUE`).
  MycoBank_CollectorThe type specimen's collector, as reported on the name's own
    MycoBank page (only when `check_locality = TRUE`).
  MycoBank_ProtologThe original-publication (protolog) citation, as reported on
    the name's own MycoBank page (only when `check_locality = TRUE`).
  MycoBank_Brazil_EvidenceLogical; `TRUE` when `MycoBank_Locality`
    mentions Brazil (only when `check_locality = TRUE`).

### Examples

```r
# All MycoBank information for a single species, only if MycoBank places
# it in Brazil
sp <- mycobank_records(taxon = "Trichoderma harzianum")

# Every MycoBank species-level name in genus Trichoderma with a Brazilian
# MycoBank locality
genus_records <- mycobank_records(taxon = "Trichoderma", rank = "genus")

# Every matching name regardless of locality, for manual review
all_records <- mycobank_records(taxon = "Trichoderma", rank = "genus",
                                      require_brazil_evidence = FALSE)
```
